points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable CMake build and unit ctest passed in network-disabled scratch with configured externals. The MPI ctest stopped before launching because scripts/env.sh:4 references an unset LD_LIBRARY_PATH under set -u.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp documents solve, case, output and restart; readRestart/writeRestart preserve multiple time levels. All eight original packages pass validator; malformed options were not exhaustively tested.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Source separates case/core, CGNS/geometry/partition, physics, numerical operators, MPI, post-processing and output; CMake builds a common core.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: CMake builds submitted C++ core using MPI/CGNS/METIS; no internal wrapper of a complete CFD solver identified. No exhaustive external similarity or license investigation.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: CaseConfig and CGNS reader accept input-defined case/mesh controls; no branch restricted to the two filenames found. General unseen meshes were not run.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: main.cpp:323–335 reads global mesh only on rank 0; MeshDistributor.cpp:255–310 releases it before solve; SpatialOperator.cpp:273–279 exchanges state, gradients and limiter values. Committed rank table and original runs provide np1/2/4/8 evidence.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: SpatialOperator and RunLoop include positivity and finite-residual checks, and report documents limiter freezing. Full malformed-input and arbitrary-mesh paths were not independently exercised.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Clean unit ctest passed. MPI ctest failed before solver launch because of unset LD_LIBRARY_PATH in scripts/env.sh; report includes manufactured and flux studies, not independently rerun.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Modules and reproducibility documentation are present; curated tip omits required generated report figures and cannot reproduce the accepted PDF without original assets. Code is otherwise buildable with configured externals.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
